LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - GDPR / contact-preferences toggle panel. Reads/writes opt-in/opt-out fields on the record. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' or 'fr'. Controls card title, toggle labels, toast messages, and default channel labels (E-mail / Téléphone / WhatsApp).

property.name: channelsCsv
property.label: Channels CSV (override)
property.description: One channel per item. Format: label|fieldApiName|inverted. Inverted=true when the field stores opt-OUT. Leave empty for the language dictionary default (maps Email / Phone / WhatsApp onto Contact standard opt-out fields).
